spec.description: Painel OrbyFlow v0.2, eventos detectados e fluxos agregados; geolocalização aproximada (MaxMind).

spec.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM orby_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)

SELECT CAST(dst_port AS CHAR) AS 'Porta',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY dst_port ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT rule_name AS 'Regra', COUNT(*) AS 'Alertas' FROM orby_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY rule_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 12

spec.title: Últimos ataques detectados (recebidos e originados)
spec.description: Detecção bidirecional (F4): origem/destino do lado da rede, IP público usado no CGNAT, protocolo e porta, principais IPs remotos. Detalhe completo, ASN e país dos remotos: painel web > Ataques.

spec.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS 'Hora',CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END AS 'Sentido',rule_name AS 'Regra',severity AS 'Severidade',CASE scope WHEN 'dedicated' THEN 'IP dedicado' WHEN 'cgnat_pool' THEN 'Pool CGNAT' ELSE 'Assinante CGNAT' END AS 'Tipo de IP',IF(subscriber_ip<>'' AND scope<>'cgnat_pool',subscriber_ip,local_ip) AS 'IP da rede',COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(details,'$.public_ips[0]'),''),IF(scope='cgnat_pool',local_ip,'')) AS 'IP público (CGNAT)',CASE WHEN detection='nat' THEN COALESCE(CONCAT(JSON_VALUE(details,'$.top_portas[0].protocolo'),'/',JSON_VALUE(details,'$.top_portas[0].porta'),' → ',JSON_VALUE(details,'$.top_portas[0].destinos'),' destinos'),'sem fluxo amostrado') ELSE CONCAT(protocol,IF(remote_port>0,CONCAT(IF(direction='in',' origem ',' destino '),remote_port),''),IF(local_port>0,CONCAT(' local ',local_port),'')) END AS 'Protocolo / porta',CONCAT_WS(', ',JSON_VALUE(details,'$.top_remote_ips[0]'),JSON_VALUE(details,'$.top_remote_ips[1]'),JSON_VALUE(details,'$.top_remote_ips[2]')) AS 'IPs remotos (principais)',remote_ips AS 'Qtd. remotos',pps AS 'Pacotes/s',mbps*1000000 AS 'Taxa',CAST(JSON_VALUE(details,'$.allocs_per_min') AS UNSIGNED) AS 'Alocações NAT/min',CAST(JSON_VALUE(details,'$.active_ports') AS UNSIGNED) AS 'Portas NAT ativas' FROM orby_attack_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT src_asn) AS value FROM orby_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND src_asn IS NOT NULL AND src_asn > 0

spec.title: Mapa de origens do tráfego Huawei — GeoLite2
spec.description: Origens públicas observadas no NetFlow Huawei, localizadas aproximadamente pela GeoLite2. Não são alertas nem locais exatos. A atualização depende da importação nfcapd → MariaDB.

spec.rawSql: SELECT t.latitude,t.longitude,COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') AS 'País',t.asn AS 'ASN',t.nome AS 'Nome',t.ips AS 'IPs de origem',t.vol AS 'Volume' FROM (SELECT src_latitude AS latitude,src_longitude AS longitude,src_asn AS asn,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(src_asn_name,'')),'Não identificado') AS nome,MAX(NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS pais,COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS ips,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_latitude IS NOT NULL AND src_longitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY src_latitude,src_longitude,src_asn ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 300) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

spec.title: PPS estimados por protocolo — Huawei
spec.description: Taxa estimada em bucket de um minuto, não medição instantânea.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),protocol AS metric,ROUND(SUM(total_packets)/60,1) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY 1,protocol ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT src_country) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_country<>''
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_bytes),0),0) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc)

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),protocol AS metric,ROUND(SUM(total_bytes)*8/60,3) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY 1,protocol ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(event_time,'1m'), COUNT(*) AS value FROM orby_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Mapa de alertas DDoS — apenas quando houver alertas
spec.description: Este painel mostra apenas incidentes com IP de origem geolocalizado. Ficar vazio quando não existem alertas é esperado.

spec.rawSql: SELECT a.src_latitude AS latitude,a.src_longitude AS longitude,COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(a.src_country,''),'Não informado') AS 'País',a.src_asn AS 'ASN',a.src_asn_name AS 'Nome',a.src_ip AS 'IP origem',a.dst_ip AS 'IP destino',a.rule_name AS 'Regra',a.pps AS 'Pacotes/s',a.event_time AS 'Data UTC' FROM orby_alerts AS a LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=a.src_country WHERE $__timeFilter(a.event_time) AND a.src_ip IS NOT NULL AND a.src_latitude IS NOT NULL AND a.src_longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.event_time DESC LIMIT 3000

SELECT t.asn AS 'ASN',t.nome AS 'Nome',t.blocos AS 'Blocos / IPs',t.ips AS 'IPs',CASE WHEN t.paises>1 THEN 'Vários' ELSE COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') END AS 'País',t.vol AS 'Volume',t.bps AS 'Taxa média',t.pps AS 'Pacotes/s médio' FROM (SELECT src_asn AS asn,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(src_asn_name,'')),'Não identificado') AS nome,COALESCE(NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(src_prefix,'') ORDER BY src_prefix SEPARATOR ', ' LIMIT 3),''),GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT src_ip ORDER BY src_ip SEPARATOR ', ' LIMIT 3)) AS blocos,COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS ips,COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS paises,MAX(NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS pais,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol,SUM(total_bytes)*8/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS bps,SUM(total_packets)/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS pps FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_asn>0 GROUP BY src_asn ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 25) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

SELECT COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') AS 'País',t.vol AS 'Volume' FROM (SELECT src_country AS pais,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_country<>'' GROUP BY src_country ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 15) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

spec.title: Trafego, ASN e Defesa DDoS
